import java.io.*;

public class Main {
  static class FastReader {
    private BufferedReader br;
    private StringTokenizer st;

    public FastReader(InputStream is) {
      br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(is));
      st = new StringTokenizer("");
    }

    public String next() throws IOException {
      while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {

        st = new StringTokenizer(line);
      }
      return st.nextToken();

    public long nextLong() throws IOException {
      return Long.parseLong(next());
    }
  }

  static final long[] repUnits = {
    0L, 1L, 11L, 111L, 1111L, 11111L, 111111L, 1111111L, 11111111L,

    11111111111111L, 111111111111111L, 1111111111111111L

    FastReader fr = new FastReader(System.in);
    long n = fr.nextLong();
    System.out.println(solve(n));
  }

  static long solve(long x) {
    if (x <= 6) return x;
    int digits = String.valueOf(x).length();
    long repUnit = repUnits[digits];
    if (x == repUnit) return digits;
    long lower = repUnit;
    long upper = repUnit * 10 + 1;
    long option1 = solve(x % lower) + (x / lower) * digits;

    if (upper - x < x) {
      option2 = solve(upper - x) + (int)Math.log10(upper) + 1;
    }
    return Math.min(option1, option2);
  }

import java.io.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
  static class InputReader {
    private final InputStream stream;
    private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
    private int ptr, len;

    public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
      this.stream = stream;
    }

    private int read() throws IOException {
      if (ptr >= len) {
        len = stream.read(buffer);
        ptr = 0;
        if (len <= 0) return -1;
      }
      return buffer[ptr++];
    }

    private long skip() throws IOException {
      int c;
      while ((c = read()) <= 32 && c != -1);
      return c;
    }

    public long nextLong() throws IOException {
      int c = skip();
      if (c == -1) throw new EOFException();
      long n = 0;
      boolean neg = false;
      if (c == '-') {
        neg = true;
        c = read();
      }
      while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
        n = n * 10 + c - '0';
        c = read();
      }
      return neg ? -n : n;
    }
  }

  static final long[] repUnits = new long[17];

  static {
    repUnits[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < repUnits.length; i++) {
      repUnits[i] = repUnits[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
  }

  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
    InputReader ir = new InputReader(System.in);
    long n = ir.nextLong();
    System.out.println(compute(n));
  }

  static long compute(long val) {
    if (val <= 6) return val;
    int d = countDigits(val);
    long r = repUnits[d];
    if (val == r) return d;
    long lower = r;
    long upper = repUnits[d+1];
    long option1 = compute(val % lower) + (val / lower) * d;
    long option2 = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    if (upper - val < val) {
      option2 = compute(upper - val) + (d + 1);
    }
    return Math.min(option1, option2);
  }

  static int countDigits(long x) {
    if (x == 0) return 1;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (x > 0) {
      cnt++;
      x /= 10;
    }
    return cnt;
  }
}
